resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firetower.org and FireLookout.com date an AWS smokehouse and platform tower to 1942. Willhite says he does not show the site as an AWS site and is unsure what that history means. The story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Brief access was unknown; Willhite gives a legal route needing a Longview-St Helens permit, so access is set to permission. The 1942 AWS origin is disputed by Willhite. The 2012 footing report is secondhand and Willhite did not find footings in 2017; neither source dates a current visit. Brief record (elevation, county, status, agency) matches the sources.
